title: Allegiant General Pryde
subtitle: Ruthless and Loyal
text:
When indirect damage is dealt to a unit: You may defeat a non-unique upgrade on it.
On Attack: If you have the initiative, deal 2 indirect damage to a player.
rules:
A player can't assign more indirect damage to a unit than it has remaining HP. Indirect damage is unpreventable and ignores Shields.
(ERRATA) Templating update: “Unique” becomes “<uq>”.
